methods.title: Methods in brief
methods.intro: Summary of the study accounts, as described in the repository README. Full calculation definitions and source provenance are in docs/PIPELINE.md and docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.
methods.forest: Forest account. Annual carbon additions to above- and below-ground living forest biomass are estimated using Gibbs/GFW gross-removal pixels for 2001-2023. Four non-mangrove mean rates are calculated for the tropical, subtropical, temperate, and boreal FAO GEZ domains and applied to FRA 2025 forest area allocated by biome. This measure does not include forest soils, deadwood, or the net ecosystem carbon balance.
methods.marine: Marine account. Published Blue Carbon Wealth (BCW) components are combined with a spatial update of mangrove area from Global Mangrove Watch 2025. The update changes mangrove area; the other BCW components and source-specific rates are retained.
methods.national: National account. Green Carbon Wealth (GCW) and Blue Carbon Wealth (BCW) are combined as Natural Carbon Wealth (NCW). If only one account is available for a unit, its available value is used as NCW and the missing component is treated as zero. The primary uncertainty draws propagate the GSCC draws. Spatial variation in Gibbs/GFW pixels is reported as a separate sensitivity, not as a confidence interval for the biome rates.
methods.note: GCW, BCW, and NCW share a monetary valuation framework, but their physical inputs use source-specific definitions. Read the account boundaries in the pipeline documentation before comparing carbon quantities; a common currency does not make the underlying fluxes physically identical.
methods.data: All values shown on this site come from the repository outputs; no external data are used. Boundaries: Natural Earth (public domain) and Marine Regions EEZ–land union v4.

aggregate.note: Totals are sums of unit means, as in the paper's region and group tables. NCW counts a missing component as zero. P05–P95 ranges are not additive and are not shown.
